items.title: Understanding Body Parts as Measurement Tools
items.explanation: Children learn that body parts like handspans, arm lengths, and footprints can be used to measure short distances. The text shows how Deepa's mother measured cloth using a metal rod while the tailor used a flexible tape, highlighting different tools for different needs.

items.title: Comparing Handspan Measurements
items.explanation: Students compare their own handspans with classmates' measurements to discover that handspan size varies between individuals. This leads to the conclusion that scales and tapes are needed because body parts have inconsistent sizes.
